name: mcardia-claude-kit
description: Mario Cardia's Claude Code kit: Spec-Driven Development generators and architecture tooling

plugins.name: sdd-generators
plugins.description: Interview-style generators for SDD governance and design documents (constitution, PRD, ADR, spec, C4, traceability, doclint, readiness-audit)

plugins.name: operator-decision-gate
plugins.description: Applies and enforces the project's own operator-decision rule: verification at source, a 4N+1 adversarial panel, a fixed record, and two hooks that refuse a handover without one. Inert in a project whose constitution has no operator-decision section — the section is authored by the constitution interview in sdd-generators

plugins.name: dependency-auditor
plugins.description: Read-only dependency health and security audit aligned with the project dependency-currency policy
